svg.text: Live Solid-State Electrolyte Screening: Proxy Evidence + Validation Roadmap
Fresh OpenClaw Materials Lab run using live Materials Project data; no offline fallback; validation protocol compiled for research-grade follow-up
Database-backed phase stability and electronic-insulation proxies, not a conductivity claim
Circle size approx. Li atomic fraction
Proxy map interpretation: candidates cluster in a low-eHull, wide-gap region, but transport validation is intentionally not inferred from this plot.
C. Evidence status and research-grade validation queue
The live run completes defensible proxy evidence and compiles, but does not execute, expensive validation tasks.
8 MP queries; offline fallback false; CSV/JSONL tables saved
shortlist satisfies eHull <= 0.1 eV screening criterion
shortlist satisfies band gap >= 2 eV minimum screen
4 JSON/CIF structures plus Li sublattice descriptor plots
protocol compiler generated citation-backed extraction task
electrochemical window plus electrode interface reaction evidence required
Research protocol compiled for 4 top candidates; 16 planned validation actions; expensive evidence gates remain approval-gated.
Interpretation: the figure presents a reproducible proxy shortlist and the generated path to research-grade validation, without implying measured ionic conductivity.
